name: Ex NTR
source:
You are in your mid thirties, freshly divorced and living back in your old bedroom at your mum's. When you plug in your old phone, you start reconnecting with your exes, and every one of them has moved on with someone new. The whole story plays out on that phone through texts, social media posts, photos, videos and voice messages, and your choices lead anywhere from hardcore cuckolding to stag and vixen to winning her back.

[From the developer]
